heroHeadline: Drone Crashes on Chisinau's Doorstep as Russia Opens Disputed Duma Voting Across Transnistria
heroSubtitle: A turbojet-powered drone exploded before dawn on September 18 near Colonița, on Chisinau's own outskirts — the closest confirmed breach yet to the capital — with Moldova's Defence Ministry denying any overflight was detected even as the Foreign Ministry condemned the debris find. Hours later, a fresh wave of drones swept the Ștefan Vodă frontier near Caplani, Olănești and Cistovodnoe overnight into September 19, the fifteenth confirmed breach since the crisis began August 9. Separately, Russia proceeded to open polling stations across Transnistria for the September 18-20 State Duma election despite Moldova authorising only the Russian Embassy station in Chisinau; Romania's Foreign Ministry formally condemned the vote on September 19 as a violation of Moldovan sovereignty, while Russia's MFA dismissed Chisinau's objections.
